en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a tranquil pond covered with water lilies in the foreground, reflecting a large historic building partially hidden behind dense trees on the far shore. The structure has a castle- or manor-like appearance with a square tower featuring crenellations and other roof elements. Handwritten text appears at the top margin, and a small printed label or watermark is visible in the lower right corner.
